function.name: get_current_datetime
function.description: Get the current date, time, and day of week. Always call this when the user asks for the time, date, or day of the week or before scheduling anything.

function.name: set_light
function.description: Turn one room's lights on or off right now. For future light changes use schedule_sequence.

function.name: get_light_status
function.description: Check whether one room's lights are currently on or off.

function.name: schedule_reminder
function.description: Schedule a spoken message that repeats until the user acknowledges it. Give in_minutes, or time with optional date.

in_minutes.description: Minutes from now, for relative times like 'in 20 minutes'.

time.description: Clock time as h:mm AM or h:mm PM. Without date, uses the next future occurrence.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD. Only valid together with time.

function.name: list_reminders
function.description: List upcoming reminders with their IDs. Call this before cancel_reminder if the ID is unknown.

function.name: cancel_reminder
function.description: Cancel an upcoming reminder by its ID from list_reminders.

function.name: acknowledge_reminder
function.description: Stop the currently repeating reminder. Call when the user confirms, dismisses, or completes it.

function.name: schedule_sequence
function.description: Schedule one or more sequential actions starting at a future time. For a single spoken message, use schedule_reminder instead.

in_minutes.description: Minutes from now, for relative times like 'in 20 minutes'.

time.description: Clock time as h:mm AM or h:mm PM. Without date, uses the next future occurrence.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD. Only valid together with time.

actions.description: Actions run in order. 'reminder' repeats until acknowledged and needs text. 'announcement' is spoken once and needs text. 'light' is silent and needs room and power.

text.description: For reminder and announcement: exact words to speak.

function.name: list_sequences
function.description: List upcoming action sequences with their IDs. Call this before cancel_sequence if the ID is unknown.

function.name: cancel_sequence
function.description: Cancel an upcoming action sequence by its ID from list_sequences.
